blocks.text: 131 Musaph for the New Year 131

adherents are faithless and the Lord intends to reject them, may his prayer avail them that on their behalf the covenant may be remembered. He remembers the noble tribes (twelve), the oath of the tribes, the wanderings of the tribes does He recall, to strengthen them. When He says that He will crush those who bear the heavy yoke, then He remembers as an atonement the destruction of the site of the Sanctuary. He remembers the foundation stones (forefathers), who groan in Egyptian slavery. The sucklings who praised the Lord at the Sea of Reeds, the promise of the covenant (the circumcision) and the statutes (of the Torah), His holy word, all these does He remember. The memory of those who live austerely (students of the Torah) and study His beautiful sayings, who with their lips provide a substitute for sacrificial bullocks, He does remember. When the books that announce what is hidden, are examined, He remembers in love the wonderful pair of brothers. He remembers the honour of the sanctuary, the place where He, the Beloved, did dwell, where He allowed the Cherubim to rest, the love of our youth He remembers. The basin on its frame, the delightful voice (of the Levites) on the Temple steps, the Almighty recalls them in favour of the discerning on the appointed day of judgment.

blocks.text: On Sabbath.

for remembrance. O Lord, in Thee do I trust and not in princes, for they are in the grave and Thy Name is for ever for remembrance. All these supported me but I seek Thy compassion, without it I should have perished and not survived for remembrance. For in spite of their strength, they could not plead for me before Thee, those in whose mouths is Thy greatness have placed it there for remembrance. For this day has been stored the sum of assessments, it is the beginning of days and the first for remembrance. On it there is read out what was engraved with a diamond quill, what was revealed and explained and known in remembrance. Death and life, peace and war, dearth and abundance, appear for remembrance. The acts of man, the number of his steps, though forgotten by men, they are to God for remembrance. “My way is hidden” — who could say that? In vain was a sin inscribed for me for remembrance. In front of man his deeds give evidence, his falsehood bears witness against him for remembrance. Proclaim the plans of the Lord, all men together, pass under the staff like a flock for remembrance. blocks.text: 132 Musaph for the New Year 132

He remembers (Joshua) the son of Nun, and the illuminating words of him who comes from Yephuneh, (Caleb), may they be recalled in prayer so that their deeds should be remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for grief, may He hear and remember the supplications of those He has favoured. He remembers the noble judges and the sign given by Samuel at the time of the wheat harvest. He heals the folly of the simple, so that it is no longer remembered. When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for the four punishments, may He remember the nature of the judgments He gave them. May He remember the hymns of praise in which David, at midnight, praised the rules of the night, may He remember his song in the darkness of the night on their behalf. May He illuminate the nightly search by the fire of the night upon the altar; the law in which they study by day and by night, may He remember for their healing. He remembers the palace that was taken from me on account of my selfishness. May He no longer recall that it was laden with deliberate sins. When anger, as at the time of the flood, is aroused in destruction, let Him remember the month of Bul (the completion of the Temple) in compassion. He re-

blocks.text: 133 Musaph for the New Year 133

members the test of every creature according to measure and in the scales; when they have committed acts of rebellion and faithlessness, may He remember them, full of compassion. As to the good and the evil whose deeds and way of life should be requited, may He not remember them according to the severity of the law. He remembers life, how long their life shall be; for death or for life He remembers all the living. The noisy throng of creatures passes before Him like lambs; He remembers each according to his worth. He remembers poverty and wealth, need and plenty, vice and virtue; in judgment does He remember. The open and the hidden, building and tearing down, death and superfluity, does He measure and remember. He remembers those who should live sheltered in the wilderness or in settlements; to send rain and wind does He remember. To hear the prayer of the people that reveres His Name and to lead back the exiles does He remember on the day of the Tekiah. He recalls terror and wrath, battle and wars; the destruction of

blocks.text: צצו

The foxes (Egyptians), the destroyers of vineyards, planned to cut off from the vine its root and remembrance. They oppressed them (Israel) with hardship, they cried out to Thee and were saved because of the piety of the forefathers who had been inscribed for remembrance.

blocks.text: ככתוב
As it is written in Thy Torah: ‘God heard their cry, then God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob’.
קדם

In days of old Thou didst see generations in whom there was no delight. Thou hast let them vanish and perish without a remembrance. One generation hast Thou chosen from among a thousand and allotted them Thy words; for their sake in every generation hast Thou engraved them for remembrance.

As it is written in Thy holy words: ‘He remembers for ever His covenant, the word He commanded for a thousand generations’.
